create_instance: create a BoltClient instance to manage private computation jobs and stages
run_stage: run a computation stage on a BoltClient instance with optional server IPs and certificates
get_or_create_instance: get an existing instance or create a new one using BoltCreateInstanceArgs
validate_results: validate the results of a private computation instance against an expected result path
cancel_current_stage: cancel the currently running stage on a BoltClient instance by instance ID
